description: Runtime dynamic dispatch is prohibited in framework runtime packages.
Runtime Activator-based construction requires an exact, reviewed exception.
Runtime generic reflection construction or invocation requires an exact, reviewed exception.
Runtime assembly enumeration requires an exact, reviewed exception.
Bypassing EF Core query filters requires an exact, reviewed exception.
Raw SQL APIs require an exact, reviewed exception and tenant-safety review.
Test projects must remain outside runtime source projects.
Test-only helpers must not leak into runtime packages.
